study: Solver-only imports with unchanged FP64 Galerkin and FD4 trajectories
purpose: Separate startup dependency cost from solver time and from random features
physical_problem: Re=100 full finite annulus, no reflection constraint, prescribed original forcing, T=72
toolchain: Original CUDA 11.8; independent modern toolchain research is excluded from this cohort
fairness: Every primary method comparison uses its minimal equivalent dependency path, including both FD controls
Selected versus minimal import is paired within the same method, seed, time schedule, observations and graph width
Uniform versus combined minimal separates schedule/preparation from import savings
Legendre versus RFM is descriptive at separately qualified retained ranks, not an equal-rank causal feature test
Independent fresh processes, no simultaneous fluid solves, same logical CPU 4 and one BLAS thread
Qualification has already warmed operating-system and driver caches; fresh process does not mean cold machine

clocks.solver_seconds: Immediately before solve/context entry through setup, march, CUDA teardown and model release; spatial fingerprint excluded
clocks.fresh_process_return_seconds: Immediately before Popen through receipt of RETURN; includes imports, identity admission and spatial fingerprint
clocks.excluded_from_both: Trajectory serialization after SAVE and numerical qualification after the cohort

monitor.window: Before first Popen through last exact child terminal and coordinator raw-hash close, with boundary samples
monitor.scope: Observed Python process lifetimes and endpoint GPU activity; entirely between-poll lifetimes and other application loads are not fully covered

reporting.startup_only_improvement: May be reported separately when fresh clock improves but unchanged solver clock does not
reporting.inference: Descriptive paired results; five block-seed pairs are not independent random-feature causal evidence
